adapters.atlas: dist/designer-panels/index.js: painters fed by the architecture (dist/designer-architecture.js, marked DESIGN) and the sample records (dist/designer-records.js, marked SAMPLE).
adapters.demo: dist/designer-elements.js and dist/designer-topology.js, unchanged byte for byte: the synthetic preview as it was before the atlas adapter (blank.html?data=demo).

registeredPanels: system-chains/the picked step of a chain
preview.labelMatching: Trim, lowercase and collapse whitespace. atlas: the painter of the box's own page (page/label), else a shared one: step boxes ("step n: name"), return and next, view tabs ("view: name"), then any linked box. demo: recognizedLabels; details only on Site.
preview.panelMap: dist/designer-panel-map.js: per element ID, the element that paints it, the adapter and feed it will use, who builds that, and what exists today.
preview.layout: handoff/designer/arachnid.flow-design.json, maintained by tools/build-designer-layout.mjs from the shipped demo layout; IMPORT it in the designer.
preview.geometry: Uses the original saved UI-cell bounds without changing the layout document.
preview.rendering: Pure sandbox painters feed the existing designer VFD framebuffer; no second compositor.
preview.dataMode: atlas (default): the design and sample records, marked DESIGN or SAMPLE, never live. demo: ephemeral synthetic demo state. Neither fetches, signs in or controls a device.
preview.topologyPlacement: Available System canvas area left of saved panels, or an explicitly named Topology/System topology rectangle; no saved geometry changes. The generated layout names a topology box on System, so atlas draws it there.

Call binding.refresh() after changing the specification to refresh its accessible label and request a shared-skin repaint. Call destroy() before removing the canvas.
No shader, animation loop or implicit persistence is created by this module.
defaultSaasState and normalizeSaasState return the bounded version-1 workspace state.
saveSaasState(state,storage) returns {state,error?,cause?}; a storage failure must remain visible to the user.
filterFleet({query,site,status}) and filterInspections(state,{query,site,status}) return matching demo records.
updateInspection(state,id,{status?,note?}) returns normalized next state without mutating its input.

Layout geometry uses integer UI-cell coordinates; each cell is eight display pixels.
Version 2 documents contain format, version, hiddenPages and pages. The storage key retains its v1 suffix.
readDesign reports blocked or malformed saved data without overwriting it.
normalizeDesign strictly validates v1 or v2 documents; v1 migrates rectangles to typed elements and adds three default hidden pages.
saveDesign writes normalized version 2 and throws on validation or storage failure.
Selection, tool state, gestures and undo/redo history are not part of the saved layout document.

notes: hasDesignElement(rect,page) checks the normalized label and page context.

allRects supplies nested geometry so a parent panel does not paint through its child boxes.
activateDesignElement(rect,{x,y},{page}) takes coordinates normalized 0..1 within the saved rectangle.
Pure painter sources are copied from sandbox-ui/elements.html dependencies; only phosphor imports are adapted to the shared display glyph/grid modules.

Fictional records shared by the detailed page previews; public OSM geometry retains its attribution.
Defines the 26-page demo layout. The builder adds missing boxes without moving existing layout geometry.
Demo binding metadata keyed by element ID; host programs supply their own data.
One module a page; each painter draws inside its box only, never inside a box nested in it, and takes every figure from the records or the architecture.
Preview state (dist/designer-panels/state.js) lives in the page and is never saved.
Reads an ARACHNID .mcap in the page (depth, camera info, pose, colour) and returns posed world points in time order, one contiguous range a frame.

The cloud so far, the frame now, the camera trail and frustum; setFrame(progress) follows the viewer timeline in recording time.
Funes scans (CC BY-NC 4.0) with their real location, OSM outline and fit; files in dist/assets/scans, made by tools/import-obj-scan.mjs.
Fits a scan or a SLAM replay under the hologram projector, metres in proportion; monuments map stage points back to latitude and longitude.
Groups main and linked pages without changing saved layouts.

droneInput.safety: Neutralize on release/cancel/lost capture/blur/hidden/destroy. Simulation does not connect to real hardware.

directRendererMarker.coordinates: world-space position; scalar converts metres to current scene world units including map zoom

insetLayout.coordinates: normalized 0..1 relative to the main canvas, top-left origin

contracts.refresh: After programmatic data-vfd dataset or geometry changes call the matching skin refresh/relayout (viewer overlay: refreshOverlay(root)).
contracts.dispose: Destroy mounts/renderers and call page cleanup functions before unmounting or rebuilding the host.

chartSpec.rendering: One integer framebuffer via canvas.vfdDraw; mountUIPagesSkin supplies shared optics.
chartSpec.persistence: Host-owned; the chart binder does not access browser storage.

flowDesign.hiddenPageId: 1-64 characters matching [a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*; unique across main and hidden pages; reserved object/document names rejected
flowDesign.hiddenPageLabel: Trimmed, nonempty text without control characters
flowDesign.pageArrays: One array for every main and hidden page ID, with at most 200 elements each.
flowDesign.geometry: Integer UI-cell coordinates within 512 by 512 cells. Rectangle minimum 4 by 3; horizontal divider height 1, width >= 4; vertical divider width 1, height >= 4.
flowDesign.link: Existing main or hidden page ID, or null
flowDesign.migration: Strictly validate a version 1 document, add type rectangle to its elements, then add blank sign-in, sign-up and reset-password pages. Reads migrate in memory without writing; the next successful save writes version 2.
flowDesign.backupBehavior: The version 3 project backup retains the exact raw designer string. It does not perform layout migration.
